section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 2. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 143 | 700 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 153 | 700 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 146 | 700 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 148 | 700 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
